transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because I can’t stop feeling like I’ve failed. As a father, and just as a useful person. It keeps going around in my head, and… it gets to where I feel like I don’t deserve much of a future.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once cared about?

Yeah… I have. I used to spend hours on my model railway, and I’d watch Cubs games with my daughter. Now the trains are just sitting there half-finished, and even turning on a game feels… kind of pointless.
Do you find yourself feeling guilty or like you’re a burden to others, even when you know you’re not?
Yeah. I… I do. It’s mostly this feeling that I’ve failed—my daughter, everyone, really. Like I’m not much use to anyone. I know people might not say that, but it just keeps going around in my head.
Do you find yourself feeling like you’re completely worthless or that you’re a burden, even when you know it’s not really true?

Yeah… I do. I know it probably doesn’t make sense to say it that strongly, but it feels like I’ve failed as a father, and as… just a useful person. It loops in my head, and after a while I start feeling like I don’t really deserve much of a future.
Have you noticed that you're moving slower than usual, or maybe more restless and unable to sit still?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed that. Maybe I’m just tired, but I can’t say I’ve been paying attention to moving slower or anything.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy lately, or do you feel more tired than usual even when you haven't done much?

Yeah… my energy’s been pretty low. Even small things, like taking laundry upstairs or just going through the mail, feel… heavy. Like I’m pushing through wet cement, even if I’ve been in bed a long time.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I mean… I’ve been pretty low, yeah. I don’t know if I’d say every minute of the day, but most days it’s there.
How long have you been feeling this way most days? Has it been going on for weeks or months?
About a month, I guess. Since my daughter left for college out of state… it’s been most days since then.
Have you had any thoughts about ending your life or that you’d be better off dead?

…Yeah. I don’t really like saying it, but I’ve had thoughts like… it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up.

And I scared myself a little because I caught myself going through my finances, like I was… getting things in order for someone else.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the opposite end, have you felt more restless or unable to sit still lately?
I… I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed anything like that. Maybe I’m quieter, but I don’t know about moving slower or being restless.
